additional_info.subject: ID0436205-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R3 170001518]  charging session CRM:02682000189
additional_info.body:
Hi Chlöe,
Since the converter is missing, there are only 3 options:
CAN communication cable is not inserted properly
CAN comm cable is defective
Converter is faulty
Do your technicians perform replacement of parts?
My recommendation is to swap this faulty converter (you need to see by SN, you cannot see it by [number]), you need to check which SN is the one missing.
After you see which is the converter that is missing, please check the following:
If the CAN cable is properly attached to the input of the converter. If this doesn't work:
Please swap with the neighbour converter, so for example, if this is TB4 swap with TB3 or TB5, to make it easier.
What I mean with swap is completely swap position and all cables attached. Please make sure you don't forget any cable.
If this works, then it's very likely that it was a cable that was not inserted properly
If this doesn't work, is the problem still in the same converter?
If yes, then please replace the converter
If no, then please replace the CAN cables.
Do you need any support from the regional colleagues?
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
